components.name: Modal
components.summary: Accessible modal dialog with header/footer actions.

demo.peerNotes: MIT Keep React (npm keep-react). Docs demos on keep-react-pi.vercel.app (GitHub homepage). react.keepdesign.io currently redirects away from docs — do not iframe that host.

components.copyCode:
npm i keep-react phosphor-react

import {
  Button,
  Modal,
  ModalAction,
  ModalContent,
  ModalDescription,
  ModalFooter,
  ModalHeader,
  ModalTitle,
} from "keep-react";

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Modal>
      <ModalAction asChild>
        <Button>Open Modal</Button>
      </ModalAction>
      <ModalContent>
        <ModalHeader>
          <ModalTitle>Update status</ModalTitle>
          <ModalDescription>Confirm to continue.</ModalDescription>
        </ModalHeader>
        <ModalFooter>
          <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
          <Button>Confirm</Button>
        </ModalFooter>
      </ModalContent>
    </Modal>
  );
}
